purposeFinding.permittedPurpose: Deliver the user-requested post-reveal equipment explanation and enforce its authorization boundary.

requiredLimits: Do not create cross-conversation equipment-interest profiles.
Do not use explanation requests, categories, declines or feature questions for marketing, advertising audiences, lead scoring or recommendation ranking.
Do not persist raw equipment interaction events beyond the current conversation/offer lifetime unless a separately documented legal basis, purpose and retention period exists.
Expire the authorization unit when the offer or conversation expires and prevent cross-offer reuse.
Redact internal evidence identifiers and raw locators from public output and general telemetry.
Keep a necessary REC contract-acceptance proof separately from feature-interest history; an acceptance proof must not preserve the user's equipment questions.
Restrict access, use pseudonymous identifiers and delete or irreversibly aggregate operational logs at the documented retention deadline.

retentionDisposition.securityLogs: ONLY_IF_SEPARATELY_JUSTIFIED_AND_DOCUMENTED; NO DEFAULT PERIOD APPROVED BY THIS REVIEW
